meta.title: Klarna Registration - Start Playing Today
meta.description: Klarna registration takes minutes. Enter your promo code, verify your account, and claim your welcome offer. Check regional availability before you sign up.

intro.text: Opening a Klarna registration takes under three minutes.

items: Click the Register button in the top right corner of the homepage
Enter your email address and create a password
Fill in your personal details (full name, date of birth, residential address)
Confirm you are 18 or older and accept the terms and conditions
Verify your email address via the confirmation link we send immediately after submission

content.text: If you have a promo code, enter it during registration. You can also add it later in your personal cabinet. Before you sign up, check our social media pages for active promo codes. We also send bonus codes to subscribers via email newsletter, so sign up for our mailing list to make sure you never miss an offer.

MGA licence requirements mandate identity verification for all players before processing withdrawals. Verification protects your account from unauthorized access and ensures your funds go to the right person.

items: Proof of identity: passport, national ID card, or driving licence
Proof of address: utility bill or bank statement dated within the last three months
Payment method verification: a photo of your card or e-wallet confirmation may be required

content.text: Upload documents directly through your account cabinet. Verification typically completes within 24 hours.

items: Regional restrictions apply: our platform is not available in all countries. Before Klarna sign up, confirm your country of residence is supported. Check the list of restricted regions in our terms and conditions page

On VPN use: we strongly advise against using a VPN to bypass regional restrictions. If our system detects a mismatch between your registered location and your actual IP address, we reserve the right to suspend your account and void any pending withdrawals. Play from your actual location only
Use your real details: any mismatch between your registration data and your KYC documents delays verification and can lock your withdrawal access

faq.title: Where can I find an active Klarna promo code?
faq.text: We publish active promo codes on our social media channels on a regular basis - follow us to stay updated. You can also receive bonus codes directly to your inbox by subscribing to our email newsletter. Codes can be entered during registration or later in your personal cabinet, whichever is more convenient.

faq.title: Can I change my registered email address after sign-up?
faq.text: Yes, but the process requires identity verification to prevent unauthorised changes. Submit a request through our support team via live chat or email and provide a valid ID document. The change takes effect within 24 hours of confirmation.

faq.title: How to recover my Klarna login?
faq.text: Click the "Forgot Password" link on the login page and enter your registered email address. You will receive a password reset link within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not appear in your inbox. Once reset, we recommend enabling two-factor authentication to protect your account going forward.
